title: Bulk structure optimization
action: Perform DFT bulk structure optimization for cubic BaZrO3 and BaTiO3 using both LDA and GGA functionals to obtain equilibrium lattice constants a0.
description: Reference calculation required to build slab models.

title: Surface slab relaxation for all terminations and functionals
action: Construct (001) slab models for both BaO- and MO2-terminated surfaces of BaZrO3 and BaTiO3 using the computed bulk lattice constants. Relax all atomic positions with LDA and GGA until forces are below threshold and energies converged.
description: Geometry optimizations for all four slabs (BZO-BaO, BZO-MO2, BTO-BaO, BTO-MO2) with both functionals. The relaxed structures are used in subsequent scored steps.

title: Atomic displacements
action: From the relaxed slab structures, compute the atomic displacements δz (in % of a0) for layers 1-3 for all material/termination/functional combinations. Write to step_01_displacements.csv.
description: Records the signed displacement of each atom from its ideal bulk position. Comparable to paper Table I.
output_schema: Columns: material (BZO/BTO), termination (BaO/MO2), functional (LDA/GGA), layer (1/2/3), atom (Ba/Zr/Ti/O), displacement_percent (float, % of a0).

title: Surface relaxation parameters
action: From the relaxed slab structures, compute the rumpling parameter s and interlayer spacing changes Δd12 and Δd23 (all in % of a0) for each material/termination/functional combination. Write to step_02_surface_params.csv.
description: Contains geometric relaxation parameters summarising surface distortion. Comparable to paper Table II.
output_schema: Columns: material, termination, functional, s (float, % a0), d12 (float, % a0), d23 (float, % a0).

title: Total energy vs displacement scans
action: Using the relaxed slab structures, perform static total-energy calculations while rigidly displacing the Ba atom (BaO-termination) or the O atom (MO2-termination) along [001] in small steps. Record total energy as a function of displacement fraction for BZO and BTO. Write to step_03_energy_scans.csv.
description: Energy curves must show the paper-observed trends: BZO total energy decreases with displacement, BTO increases or remains flat. This load-bearing step verifies the correct structural relaxation was obtained.
output_schema: Columns: material, termination, atom (Ba or O), displacement_fraction (float, fraction of a0), total_energy_Ry (float).

title: Band gap for ZrO2-terminated surface
action: Perform a band-gap calculation on the relaxed ZrO2-terminated BaZrO3 surface slab for both LDA and GGA. Report the indirect band gap in eV. Write to step_04_band_gap.csv.
description: Checks a distinct electronic structure property arising from surface relaxation.
